gallery.filename: Y Felinheli, ger y Fenai (on the Menai Straights), Gwynedd, Cymru (Wales) 03.jpg
gallery.title: File:Y Felinheli, ger y Fenai (on the Menai Straights), Gwynedd, Cymru (Wales) 03.jpg
gallery.description:
Y Felinheli, on the Menai Straights, Gwynedd, Cymru (Wales). A village and community between Bangor and Caernarfon.
Etymologically, its name comes from the Welsh y meaning the, melin meaning mill and heli, meaning brine/salt-water/sea. An alternative interpretation is from Y Felin Heulyn, "the mill on the River Heulyn", which refers to the river that runs into the village.
